newsitem.title: GERMANY: Reuters 1st ex-Frankfurt RFS market report.
newsitem.headline: Reuters 1st ex-Frankfurt RFS market report.

text.p: Below are the current average ex-Frankfurt (FRA) German mark rates for air cargo road feeder services. The groupage rate per kg is for a minimum shipment of 20kg. The full-load rate refers to a truck with 13.6 load metres and maximum load of 12 tonnes.
* The rates quoted in this report were obtained by Reuter journalists on a confidential basis from a range of airlines, road trucking companies and forwarders based at or near Frankfurt airport.
* All prices are quoted in German marks. The prices are for one-way trips and cover loading, transportation and unloading but not cargo handling.

* The tariffs represent average rates calculated from a range of prices, including standard, discount and spot rates, and are indicative of current market activity. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom. Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
